```{r}
small_fig<-function(GG){
  GG+theme(axis.title = element_text(size=8),
           axis.text = element_text(size=6),
           plot.title=element_text(size=8),
           legend.text = element_text(size=8),
           legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"line"))
}


make_hover_text <- function(df, exclude = c("x","y"), collapse = "<br>") {
  # ensure df is a data.frame
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), exclude)
  # create safe character representation for each cell
  cell_str <- function(x) {
    # avoid factors
    if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
    # convert NA to string
    ifelse(is.na(x), "<i>NA</i>", as.character(x))
  }
  # build per-row html
  hover <- apply(df[ , cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(row) {
    paste0(paste0(cols, ": ", cell_str(row)), collapse = collapse)
  })
  hover
}


prepare_tax_df<-function(PHYLOSEQ,RANK,Unass.symbol=NA,Unass.repl,
                         min_prop,top_tax,bellow_top,
                         merge_categories,prop.trans,sort_abu){
if(prop.trans==T){PHYLOSEQ=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ,function(x) x/sum(x))}
TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)
class(TT)<-"matrix"
TT[is.na(tax_table(TT))]<-Unass.repl
TT<-tax_table(TT)
tax_table(PHYLOSEQ)<-TT

PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ,taxrank=RANK)
PHYLOSEQ.merged=transform_sample_counts(PHYLOSEQ.merged,function(x) x/sum(x))

#select top taxa
NAMES<-as.character(tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)[,RANK])
TS<-taxa_sums(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
names(TS)<-NAMES
TS<-rev(sort(TS))
KEEP<-names(TS)[1:top_tax]

#
TT<-tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)
class(TT)<-"matrix"
TT[,RANK][!TT[,RANK]%in%KEEP]<-bellow_top
TT<-tax_table(TT)
tax_table(PHYLOSEQ.merged)<-TT
PHYLOSEQ.merged<-tax_glom(PHYLOSEQ.merged,taxrank=RANK)

mdf = psmelt(PHYLOSEQ.merged)

if(sort_abu==T){
  mdf[,RANK]<-as.factor(mdf[,RANK])
  ADD<-levels(mdf[,RANK])[!levels(mdf[,RANK])%in%KEEP]
  if(length(ADD)>0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP,ADD))}
  if(length(ADD)==0){mdf[,RANK]<-factor(mdf[,RANK],levels=c(KEEP))}
}

mdf
}

```



# Load data and normalize

*Lowland localities ("Nagada","Wanang","Baitabag") assigned to Mt. Wilhelm*

```{r}
load("./data/PHS.rodents.ASV_Meta_Decont_final.R")

# Normalizations
PHS.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.r<-rarefy_even_depth(PHS)

```

# Overview ilustration (heatmap)

species distribution accross mountain ranges and elevations

```{r}
SD<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.t))
names(SD)
KEEP<-c("Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others","Tribe.2","Metalokalita","Alt","Locality")

SD.sub<-SD[,KEEP]
names(SD.sub)<-c("Species","Group","Mountain.range","Elevation","Locality")

  


df_counts <- SD.sub %>%
  dplyr::count(Species, Group, Locality, Elevation) %>%
  complete(nesting(Species, Group), nesting(Locality, Elevation), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    Locality = reorder(Locality, Elevation),
    Elevation_label = paste0(Elevation)
  )

df_counts$Mountain_range<-ifelse(regexpr("^FR",df_counts$Locality)>0,"Finisterres","Mt_Wilhelm")
df_counts$Elevation_label<-factor(df_counts$Elevation_label,
                                  levels=as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(df_counts$Elevation_label)))))

df_counts$Group<-gsub("native Rattini","nat. R.",df_counts$Group)
df_counts$Group<-gsub("invasive Rattini","inv. R.",df_counts$Group)  


TT<-tapply(df_counts$n,df_counts$Species,sum)
TT.df<-data.frame(totals=TT,Species=names(TT))
df_counts<-join(df_counts,TT.df)
df_counts$Species2<-paste0(df_counts$Species," (n=",df_counts$totals,")")

# 2. Plot Heatmap
GG_heat<-
ggplot(df_counts, aes(x = Elevation_label, y = Species2, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",                  
    high = "#08306B",                 
    trans = "log1p",                  
    breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100), 
    name = "Sample\nCount"
  )+
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Group), 
    cols = vars(Mountain_range), 
    scales = "free", 
    space = "free"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Locality (Grouped by Elevation)", y = "Species")

GG_heat<-GG_heat+theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
GG_heat.s<-small_fig(GG_heat)+theme(panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
                                    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
                                    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
                                    legend.title = element_text(size=8))+
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),barheight = unit(5, "cm")))
  
GG_heat.s
ggsave(GG_heat.s,filename="./results/Overview_illust.pdf",
       width = 12, height = 15, units="cm")

```

```{r}
PHS<-prune_taxa(taxa_sums(PHS)!=0,PHS)
sum(otu_table(PHS))
sum(taxa_sums(PHS)==0)
summary(sample_sums(PHS))
PHS

names(sample_data(PHS))
KEEP<-c("ID_D", "Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others","Tribe.2", "Metalokalita","Alt","Strata","Diet","Body_mass")
RNM<- c("ID",   "Species",                           "Group",  "Metalocality","Elevation","Foraging_strata","Diet","Body_mass")
Sdata<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS))
Sdata<-Sdata[,KEEP]
names(Sdata)<-RNM
Sdata$ENA_accession<-"TODO"


write.table(Sdata,"results/Table_S1.txt",sep="\t",row.names = F, quote = F)

#Small table
Alt.mean<-tapply(Sdata$Elevation, Sdata$Species, function(x) mean(x,na.rm=F))
Alt.min<-tapply(Sdata$Elevation, Sdata$Species, function(x) min(x,na.rm=F))
Alt.max<-tapply(Sdata$Elevation, Sdata$Species, function(x) max(x,na.rm=F))

N.samples<-tapply(Sdata$Elevation, Sdata$Species, function(x) length(x))

META<-Sdata$Metalocality
META[META%in%c("Baitabag","Nagada","Wanang")]<-"Mt_Wilhelm"
Meta<-tapply(Sdata$Elevation, list(Sdata$Species,META), function(x) length(x))
Meta[is.na(Meta)]<-0


Add_data<-data.frame(Species=rownames(Meta),N.samples,Meta,Alt.mean,Alt.min,Alt.max)


Remove<-c("ID","Metalocality","Elevation","ENA_accession")
Sdata.u<-Sdata[duplicated(Sdata$Species)==F,]
Sdata.u <-Sdata.u[,!names(Sdata.u)%in%Remove]
Sdata.u<-join(Sdata.u,Add_data)
names(Sdata.u)<-c("Species","Group","Foraging_stratu","Diet",
                  "Body_mass","N.samples","N.samples.Finisterres",
                  "N.samples.Mt_Wilhelm","Elevation.mean","Elevetion.min","Elevation.max") 

dim(Sdata.u)
summary(Sdata.u$N.samples)
sum(Sdata.u$N.samples==1)
write.table(Sdata.u,"results/Table_S2.txt",sep="\t",row.names = F, quote = F)
```

#Analyses including all species

## Dominant genera - phylogeny + barplots

Per-species representation of dominant bacterial genera mapped on phylogenetic tree along with species traints (diet, body mass, life style)

```{r fig.width=15, fig.height=25, message=F, warning=F}

#Merge data up to the species level
PHS.t.sp<-merge_samples(PHS.t, "Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others")
SD<-sample_data(PHS.t)
SD<-SD[duplicated(SD$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)==F,]
sample_names(SD)<-SD$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
sample_data(PHS.t.sp)<-SD
PHS.t.sp<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.t.sp,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.t.sp.G<-tax_glom(PHS.t.sp,"Genus")
sum(apply(otu_table(PHS.t.sp.G),2,max)>0.01)
MaxAbund<-apply(otu_table(PHS.t.sp.G),2,max)


#Phylogenetic tree read + adjust tip lables
PNG.p<-read.tree("data/Joined_scaled_RH85_corrected.nwk")
LAB<-PNG.p$tip.label
LAB.sp<-gsub("^[A-Z]*[0-9]*[.][0-9]*_","",LAB)
DROP<-LAB[duplicated(LAB.sp)]
PNG.p.sp<-drop.tip(PNG.p,DROP)
NEW.t<-PNG.p.sp$tip.label
NEW.t<-gsub("^[A-Z]*[0-9]*[.][0-9]*_","",NEW.t)
NEW.t<-gsub("[.]"," ",NEW.t)
NEW.t[!NEW.t%in%sample_names(PHS.t.sp.G)]
PNG.p.sp$tip.label<-NEW.t

#Convert to ultrametric
PNG.p.sp.u <- phytools::force.ultrametric(PNG.p.sp, method="nnls")

#B) At least 10% in any species
MAX<-apply(otu_table(PHS.t.sp.G),2,max)
sum(MAX>0.10)
FF<-MAX>0.10
PHS.t.sp.G.high<-prune_taxa(FF,PHS.t.sp.G)
OT<-otu_table(PHS.t.sp.G.high)
colnames(OT)<-gsub("ASV_[0-9]*_","",colnames(OT))
Others<-1- rowSums(OT)
OT<-cbind(OT,Others)
OT.high<-OT

########TREE#####################
p12 <- ggtree::ggtree(PNG.p.sp.u, ladderize = FALSE) 

p12$data[p12$data$isTip==T,c("label","y")]
tip_pos <- p12$data[p12$data$isTip==T,c("label","y")]
tip_order <- tip_pos$label
abund<-data.frame(species=rownames(OT),OT)
abund_ordered <- abund %>% slice(match(tip_order, species))
abund_long <- abund_ordered %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -species, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  group_by(species)
abund_long2<-abund_long[,1:3]


abund_long2$taxon<-gsub(".group","",abund_long2$taxon)
TAP<-tapply(abund_long2$abundance,as.factor(abund_long2$taxon),sum)
TAP<-sort(TAP)
LEV<-names(TAP)
LEV<-LEV[LEV!="Others"]
abund_long2$taxon<-factor(abund_long2$taxon,levels = c("Others",LEV))

#Species metadata
SD<-sample_data(PHS.t.sp.G)
KEEP<-c("Strata","Diet","Body_mass","Tribe.2")
SD.sub<-SD[,KEEP]
SD.sub$species<-rownames(SD)
SD.sub<-SD.sub[!SD.sub$species=="Pseudohydromys sp. indet.",]
class(SD.sub)<-"data.frame"

####Add species names
meta_data<-data.frame(label=SD.sub$species,Group=SD.sub$Tribe.2)
tree_clean <- ape::as.phylo(PNG.p.sp.u)
tree_clean<-treeio::full_join(tree_clean, meta_data, by = "label")
p12 <- ggtree(tree_clean, ladderize = FALSE) 
p12 <- p12 + 
  ggtree::geom_tiplab(aes(color = Group), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Hydromyini" = "#1B9E77", 
                                "invasive Rattini" = "#D95F02", 
                                "native Rattini" = "#7570B3")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


p12_bars<-
p12 +
  geom_fruit(
    data = abund_long2,
    geom = geom_col, 
    mapping = aes(x = abundance, y = species, fill = taxon),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.9,
    pwidth = 8, #vetsi velikst baru
    offset = 2.5,
    axis.params = list(
      axis = "x",
      limits = c(0, 1),                     
      text.size = 2.5,
      vjust = 1
    )
  )



p12_bars<-p12_bars+theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                         legend.title = element_blank(),
                         legend.text = element_text(size=7))


set.seed(123)

mycolors <- unname(glasbey.colors(n = 32))
names(mycolors)<-levels(abund_long2$taxon)
mycolors[names(mycolors)=="Others"]<-"gray80"
p12_bars<-p12_bars+scale_fill_manual("legend", values = mycolors)
p12_bars<-
  p12_bars+guides( color = guide_legend(byrow = F)) + 
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.width =  unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.spacing = unit(0.0, "cm"),
        legend.key.spacing=unit(0.0, "cm"))   

#extact legend (taxonomy)
leg_bottom <- get_legend(
  p12_bars + 
    guides(shape = "none",color="none") + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
)

#add traits traits
head(SD.sub)
p12_bars2<-
  p12_bars +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color()+
  geom_fruit(
    data = SD.sub,
    geom = geom_point,
    mapping = aes(colour = Diet, y = species, shape = Strata,alpha=log10(Body_mass)),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.9,
    pwidth = 8, #vetsi velikst baru
    offset =  0.2) 

p12_bars2

PLOT<-p12_bars2+theme(legend.position = "none")

# legend for tratits
fake<-ggplot(SD.sub,aes(color = Diet, y = Body_mass,x=species, shape = Strata,alpha=log10(Body_mass)))+geom_point()
fake<-fake+theme_bw()+labs(color = "Diet",shape = "Life style",alpha="Body mass\n(log10-scaled)")
fake.s<-small_fig(fake)
fake.s<-fake.s+theme(legend.title = element_text(size=8))
leg_right <- get_legend(
  fake.s + 
    theme(legend.position = "right")
)

#merge plot with legends
library(cowplot)
plot_row <- plot_grid(PLOT, leg_right,nrow = 1,rel_widths = c(1, 0.15))
plot_col <- plot_grid(plot_row, leg_bottom,nrow = 2,rel_heights =  c(1, 0.2))

ggsave(plot_col,filename="results/TAX_tree_v2.pdf",width = 18, height = 18,
       units = "cm")

plot_col



```

## Quantivative analyses of dissimilarities among groups

(not included in the manuscript, but consistent with PCoA pattern)

```{r}

# Matrices to lon format, NA in upper quartile and along the diagonal
BC.m<-as.matrix(BC)
BC.m[upper.tri(BC.m,diag = T)]<-NA

JA.m<-as.matrix(JA)
JA.m[upper.tri(JA.m,diag = T)]<-NA

BC.l<-melt(BC.m)
JA.l<-melt(JA.m)


# add metadata to the long format
SD<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.r))
SD1<-SD2<-SD
names(SD1)<-paste0(names(SD1),"_first")
names(SD2)<-paste0(names(SD2),"_second")
SD1$Var1<-rownames(SD1)
SD2$Var2<-rownames(SD2)

BC.l<-join(BC.l,SD1)
BC.l<-join(BC.l,SD2)

JA.l<-join(JA.l,SD1)
JA.l<-join(JA.l,SD2)

#Remonve within-group dissimilarities
BC.l<-BC.l[!is.na(BC.l$value),]
JA.l<-JA.l[!is.na(JA.l$value),]

BC.l<-BC.l[BC.l$Tribe.2_first!=BC.l$Tribe.2_second,]
JA.l<-BC.l[JA.l$Tribe.2_first!=JA.l$Tribe.2_second,]

# Define/Identify contrasts: Hydromyini x native Rattini + Hydromyini x invasive Rattini + native Rattini x invasive Rattini
BC.l$Comp<-NA
BC.l$Comp<-ifelse((BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="Hydromyini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="native Rattini")|
                  (BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="Hydromyini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="native Rattini"),
                  "Hydromyini x native Rattini", BC.l$Comp)

BC.l$Comp<-ifelse((BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="Hydromyini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="invasive Rattini")|
                  (BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="Hydromyini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="invasive Rattini"),
                  "Hydromyini x invasive Rattini", BC.l$Comp)

BC.l$Comp<-ifelse((BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="native Rattini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="invasive Rattini")|
                  (BC.l$Tribe.2_second=="native Rattini"&BC.l$Tribe.2_first=="invasive Rattini"),
                  "native Rattini x invasive Rattini", BC.l$Comp)


JA.l$Comp<-NA
JA.l$Comp<-ifelse((JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="Hydromyini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="native Rattini")|
                  (JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="Hydromyini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="native Rattini"),
                  "Hydromyini x native Rattini", JA.l$Comp)

JA.l$Comp<-ifelse((JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="Hydromyini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="invasive Rattini")|
                  (JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="Hydromyini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="invasive Rattini"),
                  "Hydromyini x invasive Rattini", JA.l$Comp)

JA.l$Comp<-ifelse((JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="native Rattini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="invasive Rattini")|
                  (JA.l$Tribe.2_second=="native Rattini"&JA.l$Tribe.2_first=="invasive Rattini"),
                  "native Rattini x invasive Rattini", JA.l$Comp)

# Summary statistics
tapply(JA.l$value,JA.l$Comp,median)
tapply(JA.l$value,JA.l$Comp,mean)
tapply(JA.l$value,JA.l$Comp,sd)

tapply(BC.l$value,BC.l$Comp,median)
tapply(BC.l$value,BC.l$Comp,mean)
tapply(BC.l$value,BC.l$Comp,sd)

# Statistical testing based on Kruskal-Wallis test and Dunn's post hocs
kruskal.test(JA.l$value~JA.l$Comp)
kruskal.test(BC.l$value~BC.l$Comp)

dunn_result <- rstatix::dunn_test(formula=value~Comp, data=JA.l, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
dunn_result

dunn_result <- rstatix::dunn_test(formula=value~Comp, data=BC.l, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
dunn_result
```

## Alpha diversity variation among murine groups

- tested using mixed effect models
- focused on differentiation among muruine groups
- ecological covariates (e.g. diet, body mass) not cosidered to avoid collinearity
- ASV richness (Observed), Shannon and Simpson considered as alpha diversity indices
- data normalized by rarefactions
- sequencing depth not considered as it is colinear with seq. run id

```{r}
# Alpha diversity measures
RICH<-estimate_richness(PHS.r)
RICH<-data.frame(RICH,sample_data(PHS.r))

# Violin plots
A.ob<-
ggplot(RICH,aes(y=Observed,x=Tribe.2,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)

A.sh<-
ggplot(RICH,aes(y=Shannon,x=Tribe.2,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)

A.sp<-
ggplot(RICH,aes(y=Simpson,x=Tribe.2,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)


# Mixed-effect models (LR comparission of models + Tukey post-hoc testing)
m.sh<-lmer(Shannon~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
m.sh.0<-lmer(Shannon~Run+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
summary(m.sh)
anova(m.sh,m.sh.0)
summary(glht(m.sh,mcp(Tribe.2="Tukey")))


m.ob<-lmer(log10(Observed)~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
m.ob.0<-lmer(log10(Observed)~Run+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
summary(m.ob)
anova(m.ob,m.ob.0)
summary(glht(m.ob,mcp(Tribe.2="Tukey")))

m.sp<-lmer(Simpson~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
m.sp.0<-lmer(Simpson~Run+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = RICH)
summary(m.sp)
anova(m.sp,m.sp.0)
summary(glht(m.sp,mcp(Tribe.2="Tukey")))


A.ob.s<-small_fig(A.ob+theme_bw())+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
A.sh.s<-small_fig(A.sh+theme_bw())+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
A.sp.s<-small_fig(A.sp+theme_bw())+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")



ggsave(A.ob.s,filename = "results/Alpha_3G_OB.pdf",width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm")
ggsave(A.sh.s,filename = "results/Alpha_3G_SH.pdf",width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm")
ggsave(A.sp.s,filename = "results/Alpha_3G_SP.pdf",width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm")

A.ob.s
A.sh.s
A.sp.s
```

## Interindividual variation (Microbiota heterogenity)

- Subset: At least 6 individuals/species
- Distanes to species-level centroind calculated with betadisper() and subsequently analyzed by mixed models
```{r fig.width=10,fig.height=6} 

#Data filtering (species with less than 6 samples removed)
COUNTS<-summary(as.factor(sample_data(PHS)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others))
KEEP<-names(COUNTS)[COUNTS>5]
PHS.sub<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others%in%KEEP,PHS)
PHS.sub.t<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.sub,function(x) x/sum(x))
PHS.sub.r<-rarefy_even_depth(PHS.sub)

#Preparation of data for analyses (sample data + dissimilariy matrices)
SD<-sample_data(PHS.sub.t)
BC<-vegdist(otu_table(PHS.sub.t))
JA<-vegdist(data.frame(otu_table(PHS.sub.r)),method = "jaccard",binary = T)

SPEC<-as.factor(SD$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)
BC.b<-betadisper(BC,SPEC)
JA.b<-betadisper(JA,SPEC)

DF<-data.frame(DIST.bc=BC.b$distances,
               DIST.ja=JA.b$distances,
               sample_data(PHS.sub.t))

DF <- DF[order(DF$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others),]
DF <- DF[order(DF$Tribe.2),]
DF$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others<-factor(DF$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others,
                                             levels = DF$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others[duplicated(DF$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)==F])


# Mixed effect models 
m.bc<-lmer(DIST.bc~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = DF)
m.bc.0<-lmer(DIST.bc~Run+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = DF)
summary(m.bc)
summary(glht(m.bc,mcp(Tribe.2="Tukey")))
anova(m.bc,m.bc.0)

m.ja<-lmer(DIST.ja~Run+Tribe.2+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = DF)
m.ja.0<-lmer(DIST.ja~Run+(1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality),data = DF)
summary(m.ja)
summary(glht(m.ja,mcp(Tribe.2="Tukey")))
anova(m.ja,m.ja.0)

# Vizualization (violin plots for each species)
gg.bc<-
ggplot(DF,aes(y=DIST.bc,x=Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

gg.ja<-
ggplot(DF,aes(y=DIST.ja,x=Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

gg.bc.s<-small_fig(gg.bc)
gg.ja.s<-small_fig(gg.ja)

ggsave(gg.bc.s,filename = "results/Disp_3G_BC.detailed.pdf",width = 12, height = 8, units = "cm")
ggsave(gg.ja.s,filename = "results/Disp_3G_JA.detailed.pdf",width = 12, height = 8, units = "cm")

gg.bc.s
gg.ja.s

# Vizualization (violin plots for each rodent group)
gg.bc.com<-
ggplot(DF,aes(y=DIST.bc,x=Tribe.2,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

gg.ja.com<-
ggplot(DF,aes(y=DIST.ja,x=Tribe.2,color=Tribe.2))+
  geom_violin(width=1)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1,outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

gg.bc.com.s<-small_fig(gg.bc.com+theme_bw())+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
gg.ja.com.s<-small_fig(gg.ja.com+theme_bw())+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")


ggsave(gg.bc.com.s,filename = "results/Disp_3G_BC.comp.pdf",width = 12, height = 8, units = "cm")
```

# ASV prevalence patterns

- To identify ASVs shared among rodent groups and samples 
- create upset plot for supplementary materials
```{r fig.width=10}

PHS.01<-transform_sample_counts(PHS,function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
TRB<-sample_data(PHS.01)$Tribe.2

# Mean prevalences in each group
PREVS<-t(apply(otu_table(PHS.01),2,function(x) tapply(x,TRB,mean)))
PREVS<-data.frame(PREVS,tax_table(PHS.01))

# Highly prevalent ASVs (at least 30% in each rodent group) 
PREVS[apply(PREVS[,1:3],1,function(x) min(x)>0.3),]

# Group-specific ASVs

FL2<-apply(PREVS[,1:3],1,function(x) max(x)>0.3)
sum((FL1+FL2)>1)

PREVS[apply(PREVS[,1:3],1,function(x) min(x)>0.01),]
PREVS[FL,]


### Upset plot

PREV.mat<-
t(apply(otu_table(PHS.prev.01),2, 
        function(x) tapply(x,sample_data(PHS.prev.01)$Tribe.2,mean)))

PREV.mat[PREV.mat<0.01]<-0
PREV.mat[PREV.mat!=0]<-1

library(ComplexUpset)
```

# Correlation analyses

testing, if ASV-levles log2-fold changes for the Hydromyni x native rattini correlate with those for Hydromyni x native Invasive Rattus etc

```{r fig.width=10}
RN<-c(rownames(RES_H.nR.G),rownames(RES_H.iR.G),rownames(RES_iR.nR.G))
RN.t<-table(RN)
RN.t<-RN.t[RN.t==3]

RES_H.nR.G.sel<-RES_H.nR.G[names(RN.t),]
RES_H.iR.G.sel<-RES_H.iR.G[names(RN.t),]
RES_iR.nR.G.sel<-RES_iR.nR.G[names(RN.t),]

rownames(RES_H.nR.G.sel)==rownames(RES_H.iR.G.sel)

plot(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_H.iR.G.sel$log2FoldChange)
plot(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_iR.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange)
cor.test(RES_H.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,RES_iR.nR.G.sel$log2FoldChange,method = "spearman")
```

# Analysis for Hydromyni hosts

## Phylogenetic tree (for Hydromyni)

```{r}
tree<-read.tree("data/Joined_scaled_RH85_corrected.nwk")

tree$tip.label[!tree$tip.label%in%sample_names(PHS)]
sample_names(PHS)[!sample_names(PHS)%in%tree$tip.label]
is.rooted(tree)

EXCLUDE<-tree$tip.label[!tree$tip.label%in%sample_names(PHS)]
length(tree$tip.label)
tree<-drop.tip(tree,EXCLUDE)

PHS.sub<-prune_samples(sample_names(PHS)%in%tree$tip.label,PHS)
length(unique(sample_data(PHS.sub)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others))
length(unique(sample_data(PHS)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others))
sum(!tree$tip.label%in%sample_names(PHS.sub))

#unikatni vzorky
PHS.sub.unq<-prune_samples(!duplicated(sample_data(PHS.sub)$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others),PHS.sub)
```

## Aling phylogenetic tree and samples in phyloseq (for Hydromyni)

```{r}
library(phytools)
SD<-sample_data(PHS.t)
PHS.t.s<-merge_samples(PHS.t,group = "Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others") #Species merged
PHS.t.s<-transform_sample_counts(PHS.t.s,function(x) x/sum(x))
SD<-SD[duplicated(SD$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)==F,]
sample_names(SD)<-SD$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
sample_data(PHS.t.s)<-SD
sample_names(PHS.t.s)<-gsub(" ",".",sample_names(PHS.t.s))

#phyloseq for Hydro..
PHS.t.s.h<-prune_samples(sample_data(PHS.t.s)$Tribe=="Hydromyini",PHS.t.s)

#intersect phygenetivc tree x phyloseq
tree.sp.h$tip.label<-gsub("^[A-Z]*[0-9]*[.][0-9]*_","",tree.sp.h$tip.label)
tree.sp.h$tip.label[(!tree.sp.h$tip.label%in%sample_names(PHS.t.s.h))]
EXCLUDE<-sample_names(PHS.t.s.h)[!(sample_names(PHS.t.s.h)%in%tree.sp.h$tip.label)]
PHS.t.s.h<-prune_samples(!sample_names(PHS.t.s.h)%in%EXCLUDE,PHS.t.s.h)

HYDRO.p.unq<-tree.sp.h
HYDRO.p.unq.u <- phytools::force.ultrametric(HYDRO.p.unq, method="nnls")


# sum(!sample_names(PHS.t.s.h)%in%HYDRO.p.unq$tip.label)
# sum(!HYDRO.p.unq$tip.label%in%sample_names(PHS.t.s.h))
# length(sample_names(PHS.t.s.h))
# HYDRO.p.unq$tip.label[duplicated(HYDRO.p.unq$tip.label)]

NAMES<-HYDRO.p.unq$tip.label
INDEX<-sample_data(PHS.t.s.h)
class(INDEX)<-"data.frame"
INDEX<-INDEX[NAMES,]
```

### Alpha diversity - BRMS models (for Hydromyni)

- alpha diversity for rarefied dataset

```{r fig.width=10,fig.height=6} 

######## Data prep. + variance-covariance matrix
A <- vcv(HYDRO.p.unq.u)  
A <- A / max(diag(A))

RICH<-estimate_richness(rarefy_even_depth(PHS.h))
RICH<-data.frame(RICH,sample_data(PHS.h))
RICH$reads<-sample_sums(PHS.h)

RICH$Species<-RICH$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
RICH$Species<-gsub(" ",".",RICH$Species)
sum(!RICH$Species%in%HYDRO.p.unq.u$tip.label)
RICH<-RICH[RICH$Species%in%HYDRO.p.unq.u$tip.label, ]

RICH$phylo<-as.factor(RICH$Species)
RICH$species<-as.factor(RICH$Species)

RICH$Diet<-as.factor(RICH$Diet)
RICH$Diet<-factor(RICH$Diet,levels=c("herbivore","omnivore","carnivore"))

# continuous variables to z-scores
RICH$Alt.z<-scale(RICH$Alt)
RICH$Body_mass.z<-scale(RICH$Body_mass)


#########Shannon - nonphylogenetic
fit.nophy.sh <- brm(
  formula = Shannon~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1 | species)+(1| Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(summary(fit.nophy.sh))

###########Observed - nonphylogenetic
fit.nophy.ob <- brm(
  formula = log(Observed)~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1|species)+(1| Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(summary(fit.nophy.ob))
# plot(fit.nophy.ob)

###########Observed - nonphylogenetic
fit.nophy.sp <- brm(
  formula = Simpson~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1|species)+(1| Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(summary(fit.nophy.ob))
# plot(fit.nophy.ob)



####Phylogenetic models
fit.phy.sh <- brm(
  formula = Shannon~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1|gr(phylo,cov = A))+(1|species)+(1|Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(summary(fit.phy.sh))

fit.phy.ob <- brm(
  formula = log10(Observed)~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1|gr(phylo,cov=A))+(1|species)+(1|Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)

print(summary(fit.phy.ob))


fit.phy.sp <- brm(
  formula = Simpson~Run+Strata+Diet+Body_mass.z+Alt.z+(1|gr(phylo,cov=A))+(1|species)+(1|Locality),
  data = RICH,
  data2 = list(A = A),      # pass the covariance matrix
  family = gaussian(),
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1500,
  chains = 1,
  cores = 1,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.98, max_treedepth = 15)
)
```

## Betadiversity - dbRDA (for Hydromyni)

```{r fig.width=10,fig.height=12}

# prepare data.frame for analyses
ORD.df$Species2<-ORD.df$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others
ORD.df$Species2<-gsub(" ",".",ORD.df$Species2)

# Cophenetic phylogenetic distances + select relevant axes 
PHYLO.coph<-cophenetic(HYDRO.p.unq.u)
PHYLO.coph.m<-pcoa(PHYLO.coph)
PHYLO.coph.m$values #First 5 axes exceed broken stick 

PHYLO.coph.df<-data.frame(PHYLO.coph.m$vectors)
NAMES<-colnames(as.matrix(Bray))
NAMES<-gsub(" ",".",NAMES)
PHYLO.coph.df<-PHYLO.coph.df[NAMES,]
#rownames(PHYLO.coph.df)==NAMES

# Null model vs Full + forward selection of relevant axes
# all 5 axes significant 
rda_null <- dbrda(Bray ~ 1, data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_full <- dbrda(Bray ~ ., data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_selected <- ordiR2step(rda_null, scope = formula(rda_full), trace = F)
anova(rda_selected , by="margin") 
summary(rda_selected)

rda_null <- dbrda(Jacc ~ 1, data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_full <- dbrda(Jacc ~ ., data = PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])
rda_selected <- ordiR2step(rda_null, scope = formula(rda_full), trace = F)
anova(rda_selected , by="margin") 

#####Data frame for analyses#####
nperm=999
#ORD.df$Species2==rownames(PHYLO.coph.df)
ORD.df.2<-data.frame(ORD.df,PHYLO.coph.df[,1:5])


####Models for Bray-Curtis
a.bc.nf<-dbrda(Bray ~ Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) #non-phylogenetic model
a.bc.f<-dbrda(Bray ~ Condition(Axis.1+Axis.2+Axis.3+Axis.4+Axis.5)+
                Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) # phylogenetic model


# Table for phylogeny (based on model comparission)
tab_comp <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, a.bc.f, permutations = nperm))
comp_row <- tab_comp[nrow(tab_comp), , drop = FALSE]

# Table for other predictors (after control for phylogeny - marginal testing)
tab_margin <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.f, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))

total_inertia <- a.bc.f$tot.chi

joint_result <- data.frame(
  Term = "Phylogeny",
  Df = as.numeric(comp_row[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(comp_row[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(comp_row[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(comp_row[["ChiSquare"]]) / total_inertia
)

tab_margin <- tab_margin[rownames(tab_margin) != "Residual",, drop = FALSE]
marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_margin),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_margin[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_margin[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_margin[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_margin[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results <- rbind(joint_result, marginal_results)
results.bc.f<-results

# table for non-phylogenetic model
tab_margin.nf <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))
tab_margin.nf <- tab_margin.nf[rownames(tab_margin.nf) != "Residual",, drop = FALSE]
marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_margin.nf),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results.bc.nf<-rbind(c("Phylogeny","","","",""),
                    marginal_results)


####Models for Jaccard
a.bc.nf<-dbrda(Jacc ~ Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) #non-phylogenetic model
a.bc.f<-dbrda(Jacc ~ Condition(Axis.1+Axis.2+Axis.3+Axis.4+Axis.5)+
                Diet+Strata+Body_mass, data = ORD.df.2) # phylogenetic model


# Table for phylogeny (based on model comparission)
tab_comp <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, a.bc.f, permutations = nperm))

# Table for other predictors (after control for phylogeny - marginal testing)
tab_margin <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.f, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))

comp_row <- tab_comp[nrow(tab_comp), , drop = FALSE]
total_inertia <- a.bc.nf$tot.chi

joint_result <- data.frame(
  Term = "Phylogeny",
  Df = as.numeric(comp_row[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(comp_row[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(comp_row[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(comp_row[["ChiSquare"]]) / total_inertia
)

tab_margin <- tab_margin[rownames(tab_margin) != "Residual",, drop = FALSE]

marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_margin),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_margin[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_margin[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_margin[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_margin[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results <- rbind(joint_result, marginal_results)
results.ja.f<-results

# table for non-phylogenetic model
tab_margin.nf <- as.data.frame(anova(a.bc.nf, by = "margin", permutations = nperm))
tab_margin.nf <- tab_margin.nf[rownames(tab_margin.nf) != "Residual",, drop = FALSE]
marginal_results <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(tab_margin.nf),
  Df = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Df"]]),
  F = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["F"]]),
  P = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["Pr(>F)"]]),
  R2_effect = as.numeric(tab_margin.nf[["SumOfSqs"]]) / total_inertia,
  row.names = NULL
)

results.ja.nf<-rbind(c("Phylogeny","","","",""),
                    marginal_results)


# Final table 
DF.rda<-
data.frame(Response=c("Bray-Curtis","","","",
                      "Jaccard","","",""),
           rbind(results.bc.nf,results.ja.nf[,]),
           rbind(results.bc.f[,2:5],results.ja.f[,2:5]))


write.table(DF.rda, file="results/RDA_table.txt",
            sep="\t",row.names = F, quote = F)

DF.rda
```

## Phylosymbiosis (for Hydromyni)

- dissimilarities already calculated in the previous step
- Two approaches were used: Procrustes correlation and Parafit

```{r fig.width=10,fig.height=8}
###################################
#Approach no1: Procrustes analysis#
###################################

JA<-as.matrix(Jacc)
BC<-as.matrix(Bray)

NAMES<-colnames(JA)
NAMES<-gsub(" ",".",NAMES)
colnames(JA)<-colnames(BC)<-rownames(JA)<-rownames(BC)<-NAMES

COP<-cophenetic(HYDRO.p.unq.u)

JA<-JA[rownames(COP),colnames(COP)]
BC<-BC[rownames(COP),colnames(COP)]

COP.pc<-pcoa(COP)
BC.pc<-pcoa(BC)
JA.pc<-pcoa(JA)

PR.bc<-protest(BC.pc$vectors,COP.pc$vectors)
PR.ja<-protest(JA.pc$vectors,COP.pc$vectors)

SIG<-c(PR.bc$signif,PR.ja$signif)
COR<-c(PR.bc$t0,PR.ja$t0)
SS<-c(PR.bc$ss,PR.ja$ss)

DF.prot<-data.frame(Dissimilarity=c("Bray-Curtis","Jaccard"),
                    Sum_of_Sq=SS,
                    Correlation=COR,
                    p=SIG)

write.table(DF.prot,file = "results/Protest_res.txt",sep="\t",row.names = F,quote = F)

#########Protest plots
PR.bc.df<-data.frame(PR.bc$Yrot[,1:2],PR.bc$X[,1:2],Species=rownames(PR.bc$X[,1:2]))
PR.ja.df<-data.frame(PR.ja$Yrot[,1:2],PR.ja$X[,1:2],Species=rownames(PR.ja$X[,1:2]))
```

## Linda: Genus level (for Hydromyni)


```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=8}

#phyloseg
PHS.h.g<-tax_glom(PHS.h,taxrank = "Genus")
taxa_table<-data.frame(otu_table(PHS.h.g))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(PHS.h.g))

class(taxa_table)<-"data.frame"
class(metadata)<-"data.frame"

metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others<-as.factor(metadata$Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)
metadata$Body_mass
metadata$Alt.Z<-scale(metadata$Alt)
metadata$Body_mass.Z<-scale(metadata$Body_mass)
metadata$Metalokalita[metadata$Metalokalita%in%c("Nagada","Wanang","Baitabag")]<-"Mt_Wilhelm"
metadata$Diet<-factor(metadata$Diet,levels=c("herbivore","omnivore","carnivore"))

Linda_iR.nR.G<-
  linda(
    feature.dat=t(as.matrix(taxa_table)),
    meta.dat=metadata,
    formula="~Run+Metalokalita+Body_mass.Z+Strata+Alt.Z+Diet+
    (1|Species_consensus_ddRAD_mt_others)+(1|Locality)",
    feature.dat.type = c('count', 'proportion'),
    prev.filter = 0.1,
    mean.abund.filter = 0, 
    max.abund.filter = 0,
    is.winsor = FALSE,
    outlier.pct = 0.03,
    adaptive = TRUE,
    zero.handling = c('pseudo-count', 'imputation'),
    pseudo.cnt = 0.5,
    corr.cut = 0.1,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    alpha = 0.05,
    n.cores = 1, 
    verbose = TRUE
  )

##results###
Linda_long<-function(LINDA){
  long_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(LINDA$output), function(varname) {
    df <- as.data.frame(LINDA$output[[varname]])
    # ensure taxa are a column (rownames in output correspond to taxa)
    df$taxon <- rownames(df)
    df$variable <- varname
    # keep columns you want; adjust/select more if desired
    df %>% dplyr::select(taxon, variable, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, reject, df)
  }),
  .id = NULL
) %>%
  arrange(taxon, variable)
long_results
} 

Linda_res<-Linda_long(LINDA=Linda_iR.nR.G)
Linda_res<-Linda_res[grep("^Run",Linda_res$variable,invert = T),]

SELECT<-unique(Linda_res$taxon[Linda_res$padj<0.05])

Linda_res_SIG<-Linda_res[Linda_res$taxon%in%SELECT,]
SIG_MAT<-Linda_res_SIG[,c("taxon","variable","padj")]
EFF_MAT<-Linda_res_SIG[,c("taxon","variable","log2FoldChange")]
SIG_MAT.w<-reshape(SIG_MAT, idvar = "taxon", timevar = "variable", direction = "wide")
EFF_MAT.w<-reshape(EFF_MAT, idvar = "taxon", timevar = "variable", direction = "wide")
rownames(SIG_MAT.w)<-SIG_MAT.w$taxon
rownames(EFF_MAT.w)<-EFF_MAT.w$taxon

EFF_MAT.w<-EFF_MAT.w[,2:dim(EFF_MAT.w)[2]]
SIG_MAT.w<-SIG_MAT.w[,2:dim(SIG_MAT.w)[2]]
EFF_MAT.w[SIG_MAT.w>0.05]<-0

EFF_MAT.w.eff<-EFF_MAT.w
EFF_MAT.w.eff[abs(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<1]<-0
colSums(EFF_MAT.w.eff!=0)
colSums(EFF_MAT.w!=0)

colnames(EFF_MAT.w)<-gsub("log2FoldChange.","",colnames(EFF_MAT.w))
colnames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<-gsub("log2FoldChange.","",colnames(EFF_MAT.w))
colnames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<-c( "Elevation","Body mass","Herbiv. x Carniv.","Herbiv. x Omniv.","Mt. range (Fin. x M. Wil.)","Scansor. x Terrest.")

EFF_MAT.w.eff<-EFF_MAT.w.eff[rowSums(abs(EFF_MAT.w.eff))!=0,]
dim(EFF_MAT.w.eff)

rownames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)<-gsub("ASV_[0-9]*_","",rownames(EFF_MAT.w.eff))

####Prevalences######

EFF_MAT.w.eff

OTU_MAT<-otu_table(PHS.h.g)
class(OTU_MAT)<-"matrix"
colnames(OTU_MAT)<-gsub("ASV_[0-9]*_","",colnames(OTU_MAT))
PREVALS<-colMeans(OTU_MAT>0)

PREVALS.ordered<-PREVALS[rownames(EFF_MAT.w.eff)]

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Prevalence = anno_barplot(
    PREVALS.ordered,
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey30", col = NA),
    width = unit(1, "cm")
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  annotation_name_rot = 0
)


pdf(file = "results/Hydro_Linda_GEN.pdf", width=8/2.54, height=15/2.54)
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(as.matrix(EFF_MAT.w.eff),
                        cluster_columns = FALSE,
                        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                        column_names_rot = 45,

  draw(heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```
